sources.description: The 2024 NFL Draft saw an unprecedented run on quarterbacks, with six coming off the board in the first 12 picks. A few years later, how do these half-dozen signal-callers stack up? Bucky Brooks provides his trust rankings, 1-6. Is Caleb Williams on top? Where do Jayden Daniels and J.J. McCarthy slot in?
